第976章 新的秩序与天外来客（大结局）-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
第976章 新的秩序与天外来客（大结局）-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
但让他们更加惊讶的还是那个和玩偶战斗到现在， 甚至取得一定优势的男人。
虽然之前通过于渊等人的描述，知道这个玩偶十分强大，是比神话级血腥主宰还要强大的存在。
【生命最后的绽放】虽然能将他的潜力全部开发，但这是以生命为代价的，况且只能持续十分钟。
在于渊的视野中，成千上万的玩偶扑来的身影内，有一个玩偶身上散发着刺目的光芒。
再出现时已经来到那道身影的背后，手中重锤再次带着火红色烈焰轰然砸下。
玩偶本体根本没想到自己已经隐藏了身形，竟然还是第一时间被找到。
随着于渊怒吼，重锤再次砸在玩偶本体身上，只不过虽然砸中，但玩偶本体却避开了头颅。
在玩偶本体砸落的瞬间，数条游戏规则锁链就已经缠绕而上，阻止下落的同时，重锤再次砸下
紫黑色的气息弥漫整个游戏竞技场，但这些气息犹如无根之萍，在汹涌规则火焰下，顷刻间就被炼化。
玩偶本体的头颅在地面滚动，想要挣扎，但没有了傀儡丝线和灵魂傀儡，只能勉强将头颅悬浮于空中。
于渊上前一把将头颅拿在手中，游戏规则之力化作的火焰在手中升腾。

Chapter 976 The New Order and Visitors from Beyond the World (Grand Finale) - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgraded from the Sewers"
Chapter 976 The New Order and Visitors from Beyond the World (Grand Finale) - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgraded from the Sewers"
But what surprised them even more was the man who had fought with the doll until now and even gained a certain advantage.
Although I knew from the descriptions of Yu Yuan and others that this doll was very powerful, it was even more powerful than the mythical bloody master.
[The last bloom of life] can fully develop his potential, but it comes at the cost of life, and it can only last ten minutes.
In Yu Yuan's field of vision, among the thousands of dolls rushing towards him, there was a doll that was emitting a dazzling light.
When he reappeared, he was already behind the figure, and the heavy hammer in his hand slammed down again with fiery red flames.
The doll's body didn't even expect that it had hidden its figure, but it was found immediately.
As Yu Yuan roared, the heavy hammer hit the doll body again, but although it hit, the doll body avoided its head.
The moment the doll body fell down, several chains of game rules were already wrapped around it. While preventing the doll from falling, the hammer came down again.
Purple-black aura filled the entire game arena, but these auras were like rootless roots, being refined in an instant under the raging flames of rules.
The doll's head rolled on the ground, trying to struggle, but without the puppet silk thread and soul puppet, it could only barely keep its head suspended in the air.
Yu Yuan stepped forward and took the head in his hand, and the flames transformed from the power of the rules of the game rose in his hand.
